prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production GAME TEXTURE ATLAS, square 1024x1024, exact 2 by 2 equal quadrants. Each quadrant is an edge-to-edge flat overhead floor texture, no objects, no shadows of objects, no perspective convergence, no labels or borders. Top-left quadrant: warm sun-worn pirate tavern wooden plank floor, honey brown, boards with nail heads and subtle gaps. Top-right: tropical pirate hideout weathered cream limestone cobblestones, mossy cracks. Bottom-left: old pale driftwood deck planks for sunny wharves, salt-worn blue-grey warm wood. Bottom-right: compact warm golden sand with a little gravel and very subtle footprints. Premium painterly 3D adventure game art, stylized realistic tactile materials, friendly vivid sunlit palette. Balanced ambient daylight, flat textures tile cleanly at their own borders, no obvious large motif, no text, no icons, no watermarks. These 4 separate textures will fill rooms in a randomly generated pirate hideout.

Production sprite atlas for a premium colorful pirate adventure videogame. EXACT 4 columns by 3 rows, 12 completely separated items on a TRANSPARENT background. Uniform equal cells and consistent object scale, each wholly contained in its own cell with generous 18% transparent padding. No grid lines, labels or text. Slightly overhead orthographic camera, front and top visible, soft ambient daylight from upper left, polished painterly 3D game art. Row 1 left to right: closed curved-top pirate treasure chest with gold fittings; round weathered wooden rum barrel; small square wooden cargo crate with diagonal brace; thick tan rope neatly coiled with a short loose end. Row 2 left to right: squat emerald glass rum bottle with cork; large terracotta earthenware urn; copper tea kettle; bulging tied canvas sack of flour. Row 3 left to right: wicker basket with silver fish; rustic short three-legged wooden stool; nautical brass oil lantern softly glowing warm gold; small potted tropical palm in a clay pot. All twelve silhouettes readable when small. Isolated items without backgrounds or floor panels. Beautiful tactile materials, charming and nautical, consistent sunlit warm tropical color palette. The atlas will be sliced into twelve rectangular equal cells for use as game sprites. Make background genuinely transparent.

Production environment sprite atlas for colorful pirate adventure game. EXACT THREE columns and TWO rows, six separate environmental furniture sprites on truly TRANSPARENT background, no tiles, no floor, no text, no labels, no gridlines. Equal rectangular cells, uniform consistent scale, generous 15 percent empty transparent padding around each object. Slightly overhead orthographic front/top view matching cozy pirate game props, vivid warm tropical daylight, richly detailed painterly 3D stylized materials. TOP ROW left to right: short black iron pirate cannon on weathered four-wheel wooden carriage; a red and cream striped hammock suspended on its own compact curved wooden standing frame; a low rectangular pirate tavern table with a parchment treasure map, ceramic dishes, tiny mugs and compass on top. BOTTOM ROW left to right: freestanding weapon rack of three crossed cutlasses and shields; compact stack of three wooden cargo crates secured with ropes and small red cloth; small rustic galley cooking stove in brick and cast iron with a copper saucepan on top. Silhouettes must not overlap adjacent cells. No scenery or background shadows extending outside cells. Beautiful premium cozy nautical art for a top-down hide-and-seek videogame.

Use case: stylized-concept. Vertical 2:3 premium videogame key art for a playful pirate hide-and-seek adventure. A gorgeous sunlit tropical pirate hideout built from cozy taverns, captain's rooms and cargo sheds on wooden docks above vivid turquoise water. Elevated three quarter camera, layered winding wooden bridges, ropes, little flags, barrels, lanterns, treasure chests, plants, a red hammock, an old cannon. A charming imposing demon king in dark teal cape with small golden horns and lantern is searching a dock, while a wooden barrel, treasure chest and fish basket subtly scurry around a corner with tiny mischievous ghost wisps peeking out. Warm late afternoon sunlight, rich teal and honey gold palette, inviting exploration and a sense of playful suspense. Crisp readable silhouettes, high-end painterly 3D fantasy game illustration, tactile wood and sparkling clear seawater. Vibrant and friendly, not horror. Leave lower quarter relatively simple dark wooden wharf for HTML title overlay. Full bleed composition. No lettering, no UI, no logo or watermark.
